meta.title: translationCore Mobile | Record Scripture in your language
meta.description: Record Scripture in your own language on Android, iPhone, or the web. Free, open source, and works offline.

hero.h1: Record Scripture in your own language
hero.p3: One passage at a time, on the phone you already have. Works offline.

what.h2: A simple app for oral translation
what.p: Record by book, chapter, and segment. Listen back, fix, and share, all on your phone.

why.p2: No accounts, no ads, and no tracking.
why.p3: Large icon buttons, built for teams who work by ear.
why.p4: From unfoldingWord, shaped by facilitators and testers.

how.span: Record a segment, then listen back.
how.span2: Fix it by cutting part of the waveform, or record it again.
how.span3: Mark Done when the segment is ready.
how.span4: Share a chapter as an MP3, or a book as a zip.

btservant.label: BT Servant
btservant.h2: Talk through a passage before you record.
btservant.p: Ask by voice or text, listen to the guidance, then return to translationCore Mobile to record.

install.p2: Android 7.0 or later, with WebView up to date.
install.p3: Search “translationCore Mobile” on the App Store.
install.a2: Get it on the App Store
install.p5: Open it in your browser. Nothing to install.
